subject: AcmeTech evaluation datasets & MAP — exchange workflow and close cadence
messages:
From: Lauren Porter <lauren.porter@acmetech.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmetech.com
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / dataset exchange — next steps

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. Procurement asked me to stitch together a concise plan for the evaluation material exchange so they can sign off internally. High level we need: a mutual action plan (owner / dates / acceptance gates), the evaluation prompt pack (sample + format), and a clear usage covenant for the data during the 30-day trial.

Can you propose a draft MAP and a sample pack we can run locally? Important constraints from legal/procurement:
- Data must remain ephemeral — no retention beyond the 30-day sandbox window.
- No external sharing; only named engineers on our team may access the prompt pack.
- Audit log export for token-level usage is required at the end of the trial.

We are targeting a decision by 3/20 so would need a close cadence that gets us to procurement signature by then.

Thanks,
Lauren Porter
Sr. Product Manager, AcmeTech
[Attachment: acmetech_req_summary.pdf (pdf, 34KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Porter <lauren.porter@acmetech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / dataset exchange — next steps

Hi Lauren — great to meet during the demo. I've pulled together a draft MAP and a minimal prompt pack sample so your team can run a smoke test. Attaching: acmetech_map_v1.xlsx (MAP with owners/milestones) and a promptpack_sample.tar.gz (5 sample prompts + README).

Summary of what we propose:
- MAP milestones
  1) 3/04: Red team smoke run (Acme devs consume prompt pack)
  2) 3/09: Shared evaluation (joint test run; Redwood provides token-level logs)
  3) 3/13: Quality review (metric pass/fail and open issues)
  4) 3/18: Final procurement sign-off and DocuSign
- Usage constraints (we will embed in the MAP sheet):
  • 30-day ephemeral sandbox — all material auto-wiped from Redwood sandbox after 30 days
  • Access limited to named Acme emails provided to us prior to delivery
  • No redistribution; no public benchmarks or publication without mutual consent
  • Redwood will provide an audit export (CSV) of per-token usage at the end of the trial

A couple of implementation notes:
- The prompt pack is packaged with a lightweight runner and a README that describes how to reproduce the test harness locally; that runner intentionally does not include any customer data.
- For the smoke run we can provide a short-lived signed URL (24h) for the pack or push to a customer-only S3 bucket if you prefer.

Marissa (cc) — can you validate the MAP milestones versus our standard ephemeral-handback playbook? Connor — can you outline the tokens/log export format we will deliver on 3/09?

If that looks good to you, I can convert the MAP to a DocuSign envelope and route to your procurement for signature.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acmetech_map_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)]
[Attachment: promptpack_sample.tar.gz (tgz, 1.1MB)]

From: Lauren Porter <lauren.porter@acmetech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmetech.com
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / dataset exchange — next steps

Thanks Mina — reviewed with procurement and security. A few clarifications before we sign:
- Can Redwood commit to automatic deletion of all prompt-derived artifacts on day 31 and provide a signed attestation?
- Token-level export: we need a mapping that excludes raw prompts but includes anonymized prompt hashes plus per-token counts and timestamps.
- Can the named-access list be updated once during the trial window (we may need to add two contractors)?

If you can confirm these points and update the MAP to reflect a 3/18 DocuSign target, we'll fast-track internal approvals.

Also — one ask from product: can you include a short acceptance checklist so our QA team can mark pass/fail criteria during the 3/09 joint run?

Lauren
Sr. Product Manager, AcmeTech

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Porter <lauren.porter@acmetech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / dataset exchange — next steps

Lauren — quick update and confirmations:

- Deletion & attestation: yes — Redwood will run an automated wipe job on day 31 and supply a signed attestation (PDF) the following business day. We'll add the attestation step to the MAP (row 5).
- Token export format: Connor will deliver an anonymized CSV as discussed (prompt_hash, anonymized_user_id, timestamp_utc, token_count, model_version). Connor: see inline below for column names.
- Named-access updates: we can accept up to one roster change during the 30-day window; we'll require a written request from an Acme admin email. We'll document the process in the MAP.
- Acceptance checklist: added a one-page QA checklist to the prompt pack README with pass/fail gates (latency threshold, top-1 correctness toggle, hallucination rate sample).

Next actions:
1) I will upload an updated acmetech_map_v1_locked.xlsx and replace the promptpack with the checklist in the README by 3/11 EOD.
2) Marissa will prepare the DocuSign envelope for the 3/18 signature target.
3) Connor will share a sample anonymized-token export schema and a small example CSV by 3/09.

Marissa — can you confirm you have bandwidth to assemble the DocuSign package and the attestation template?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: promptpack_sample_with_checklist.tar.gz (tgz, 1.2MB)]
